svg.title: Stormtide Terraces — Storm-screen terraces
svg.desc: Storm shutters and shell screens divide two retreat terraces. An anchored repair gantry stays behind the shell-chip lanes; rigging leads to a weather lookout. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops

svg.text: Storm shutters and shell screens divide two retreat terraces. An anchored repair gantry
stays behind the shell-chip lanes; rigging leads to a weather lookout.
7 raised landings · 2 stair flights · 3 rope climbs · 2 ladders · 20 placed props
R = same-map recovery · structural concept, not an exported collision mesh
P1 Tidewharf Landing · P2 Blackwater Reef
Encounter: Stormshell Skitter · proposed in [Tidekin region design](0023-tidekin-sea-region.md).
DESIGN-0014 / DESIGN-0022 / DESIGN-0023 · MAP ATLAS / SEPTEMBER 2026
